aboutProject.title: About Project
aboutProject.body: Unitech Grand Sampan Resort is a boutique beachfront development located along Marine Drive, Innani, situated in the secured area of 'Rupayan Beach View Project'. Designed for serene oceanfront living, the project blends hospitality and fractional ownership to provide premium stays and sustainable returns.
aboutProject.h1: Prime location with direct beach access
aboutProject.h2: 64 suites, each with private balcony and sea breeze ventilation
aboutProject.h3: Rooftop café designed for sunset dining
aboutProject.h4: Concierge and modern amenities in a cozy, luxury format

about.suitesIntro: Suites are offered in Standard, Deluxe and Premium categories, balancing comfort, space and amenities for different guest needs.
about.standard1: Open-plan with seating and ergonomic workstation
about.standard2: King bed, premium linens, pillow selection
about.standard3: 43″ Smart TV, international channels, high-speed Wi‑Fi
about.standard5: In-room safe; hairdryer; iron on request
about.standard6: Rainfall shower; eco toiletries; daily towel service
about.deluxe1: Separate living and bedroom for privacy
about.deluxe2: Sofa set with coffee table for lounge or meetings
about.deluxe3: 50″ Smart TV in living; additional TV in bedroom
about.deluxe4: Mini‑fridge; upgraded specialty teas and coffees
about.deluxe6: Spacious bath; premium toiletries; slippers and robes
about.premium1: Higher floors with expansive views and quiet
about.premium2: Grand living area with dining table
about.premium3: Executive desk with USB‑C; cordless phone
about.premium5: Late checkout (subject to availability); turn‑down service
about.premium6: Bathtub plus separate rainfall shower; luxury toiletries
about.compoundIntro: We are a member of the Rupayan Beach View project. The compound provides a comprehensive set of amenities and services for guests and owners.
about.c11: Pickup and drop‑off facility (airport, train station)
about.companyIntro: Unitech develops hospitality-led coastal projects with an emphasis on durability, guest experience and long-term stewardship. The Grand Sampan initiative brings a refined, small-scale luxury experience to Cox's Bazar's iconic shoreline.
about.co1: Experience in coastal developments and boutique hospitality
about.co2: Transparent fractional model with investor services
about.co3: Local operations team for daily guest excellence
about.co4: Commitment to environmental and community standards
about.directorsHint: Meet the people leading Unitech Grand Sampan Resort.

concierge.location: We're on Marine Drive Road, Rupayan Beach View Innani, Cox's Bazar.
concierge.payment: You can reserve from 10% today, or pay more now to save. Tell us what you can pay today and each month — we'll suggest a plan.
concierge.plans: Live share plans are listed with the amount needed to reserve today. Open a suite to pick how much you pay now.
concierge.reserve: To reserve: choose a suite, pick how much to pay today, add your details and photos, then send the first payment by cheque, cash, or transfer. We confirm once it arrives.
concierge.contact: Email info@grandsampan.com or call +880 17 0000 0000 — we'll help you from there.
concierge.terms: Our terms are on the site if you'd like to read them before reserving.
concierge.faq: Common questions are in the footer FAQ. You can also ask me here.
concierge.visit: Happy to arrange a site visit. Share a preferred date and time and we'll confirm what's free.
concierge.availability: For a holiday stay, check dates on Book a Stay. For ownership, availability is shown on each share plan.
concierge.suite: Suites come in Standard, Deluxe, and Premium, with sea or hill views. Each share is a set number of days per month.
concierge.returns: Pick a suite, then a share on that suite. Occupancy and daily rate stay adjustable; days and size come from the unit.
concierge.fallback: I can help you browse suites, estimate what to pay today, or point you to the team.
